d: Donald Trump has claimed that the United States is leading China by a year, possibly more, in the race for super intelligence. Speaking at the Kennedy Space Center, Trump declared that whoever wins the super intelligence race wins, adding that America would emerge victorious under his administration. He also outlined America's space ambitions, promising a return to the Moon before the end of his term and a permanent lunar presence soon after.
